summary: Inspected books/projects/abnf/tree-operations/deftreeops-doc.lisp (25620 bytes). This is an XDOC documentation file for the deftreeops macro in the ABNF library. It formally documents a macro that generates grammar-specialized tree matching predicates, tree operations, and accompanying theorems in ACL2. The file contains detailed specifications of all generated functions (defun/define), macros (defmacro), and theorems (defthm) with their rule classes, enabling conditions, and fixing theorems. This is formal mathematical content — documentation of a verified macro that produces formal definitions and proofs — and belongs in the primary search index.
